contributionMap.claim: Binary model, n experts with at most m signals, exact calibrated reports, T past cases, delta <= 1/32: the minimax excess Brier risk is of order min{1, log(1/delta)/T + min(eta, m^n/T)} for every bound eta on the conditional total correlation, attained by one estimator that does not know eta
